# Repeated signal-function component pins

This regression uses a tooling-authored `NetlistContract` generated by
`tests/design_lint_fixtures/repeated_signal_pin_functions.py`. The synthetic
fault assigns two `READY` input pins on one fitted component to separate nets;
the control assigns both pins to one net. No project schematic, board, or
proprietary source is used.

The rule is opt-in because duplicated functions may describe separate
channels or modes. Its result asks for review and does not say the pins should
be tied. The synthetic cases also cover connector and DNP exclusions, generic
and incomplete metadata, different electrical types, and open assignments.

Run the focused tests with:

```sh
.venv/bin/python -I -m pytest tests/test_component_repeated_signal_pins.py \
  -m 'design_lint and component_lint and design_lint_rule(rule_id="component.repeated_signal_pin_assignment_divergence")'
```
